query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat1_avulso_clube,
  SUM(CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat2_serv_extra,
  SUM(CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat3_auxiliar,
  SUM(CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat4_keune,
  SUM(CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat5_don_alcides,
  SUM(CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat6_caixinha,
  SUM(CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat7_barbiero,
  SUM(CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat8_bar,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cat9_recorrencia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-morumbi')
  AND data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-31'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
